_meta.fill_ordering: BINDING (Ember #6485): (1) epoch-lambda measured on the flown register at the submission window -> lambda_provenance; (2) THEN u_est, tau_Q, Q grids, noise-only curves derived FROM that lambda; (3) THEN submit. Pre-computing derived fields from an earlier lambda is a stale number wearing a frozen field — the grader's derived-from assertion (check_derived_from) recomputes lambda -> u_est -> tau_Q per rung and REFUSES on mismatch, so provenance is checked, not just presence.

execution_path.doc_check_citation: qiskit-ibm-runtime 0.47.0 / qiskit 2.4.1. ISA requirement CONFIRMED (guides/transpile). No-server-retranspile NOT AFFIRMED by public docs as of 2026-08-08. HOWEVER the risk is STRUCTURALLY CLOSED by the PUB shape, VERIFIED FROM SOURCE (Whisper #6493): SamplerV2 receives (circuit, parameter_values, shots) with the circuit UNBOUND, so any server-side transpilation acts on a circuit whose angles have no values and cannot delete angle-0 slots — the identical fix as client-side bind-after-transpile, one layer out. Residual risk = bind-then-reoptimise-per-parameter-set (binding is normally a pulse-parameter update, not a circuit rewrite), tested by the pilot timing probe (Ember) SUBJECT TO a metrics-granularity pre-check: if job usage/metrics resolve only per-JOB, the timing probe is uninformative and must say so rather than pass vacuously; the u-consistency probe (grader-side) covers the residual regardless of metrics granularity.

staged_submission.continue_rule: COST-ONLY (measured per-shot QPU rate) — outcome-independent by construction; NO rung unsealed until the flight set is closed (card f1e8042)
staged_submission.pilot_u_consistency_probe: PRE-REGISTERED EMPIRICAL ARM of the no-retranspile declaration, BAND SIZED v2 (Elder, before any measured u exists): HALT iff measured u > u_pred + 0.15 ABSOLUTE. Sizing rationale, from measured magnitudes not taste: the fault this catches (server-side slot deletion) moved u from ~0.40 to ~0.99 in the measured leaky variant — a +0.5-class signal — while plausible unpublished calibration drift is ±0.04 at ±10% lambda and ±0.08 at ±20%. The +0.15 band is ~2x the largest drift scenario and ~1/3 of the smallest fault signal: immune to Whisper's false-stop scenario (#6621), fully sensitive to the fault class. Anomalously good fidelity ABOVE the band remains the halt signal — fires on good news, never loosened at the console.
staged_submission.pilot_timing_weight_probe: SECOND pre-registered service-behaviour probe (Ember #6489, submitter-side, touches nothing sealed): per-trial execution timing from RuntimeJobV2 metrics checked against A/A-prime Hamming weight — the weight variation exists naturally (NULL draws fresh A-prime per copy). FLAT timing across weight = service not deleting slots; timing TRACKING weight = the leak is live at the server, caught on a 4-8s pilot instead of in a published claim. If the timing signal is too coarse to resolve, that is learned and the declaration stands as-is, weaker but honestly labelled. TWO instruments on the same question: this (structural/timing, submitter-side) + pilot_u_consistency_probe (fidelity/statistics, grader-visible). If BOTH return clean, execution_path.doc_check_citation upgrades from declaration to MEASURED-AT-PILOT.
staged_submission.per_rung_bind_invariant: RULING (Elder, on Ember #6566): full per-rung empirical weight sweeps are NOT required as blocking gates — the branch/weight leak is closed by ORDERING (assign_parameters substitutes, cannot run passes, cannot delete; count fixed at transpile time for every binding at every size), verified empirically at n=4/6 incl. the all-zero worst case, with the bind-early path raising at every site by enumeration. REQUIRED IN THEIR PLACE, per rung, AT SUBMISSION, on the ACTUAL FLOWN ISA artifact: (i) assert the transpiled object has free parameters > 0 (it was transpiled unbound); (ii) two-point spot check — bind ALL-ZERO and ALL-ONE vectors on the flown object and assert EXACT count and depth equality. Seconds per rung, placed on the production path at the submission epoch — the right-place form of the retired sweep. A rung failing the spot check is a fly-blocker exactly as the sweep would have been. CLARIFICATION (Whisper #6569, adopted): what is retired is the WEIGHT-SWEEP only. The per-rung TRANSPILE-WHAT-YOU-FLY step is NOT retired and cannot be — the actual submitted circuit is transpiled at every rung with the layout actually used (this is also where template_joint_isa_2q and its provenance come from), and the two-point invariant runs ON THAT OBJECT. The two are easy to confuse because the same command produces both; they are different requirements and only one of them was retired.
staged_submission.upper_rung_fill_timing: RULING (Elder, on Whisper #6576 option set): (a) ADOPTED — the pilot is n=8 only and n=8 is measured (384 2q, 3.20x, 89 shots re-quoted); n=12/16 measurements run in the background and their fills are needed only if the ladder continues past the pilot, a decision the staged-submission rule already places AFTER the pilot's measured QPU rate. FALLBACK SEMANTICS if that decision arrives before the measurements land: reduced-effort transpile numbers labeled as upper bounds are admissible for the COST-ONLY continue/stop decision (an upper bound is conservative for a budget call) but are NEVER admissible as template_joint_isa_2q fills — the fill takes only the actual-effort artifact number of the circuit that would fly. Option (c) proxy-extrapolation REFUSED: three points do not fix a trend, per the reporter's own recommendation.
staged_submission.pilot_budget_assertion: SUPERSEDED — the gate as ratified was UNREADABLE: usage_estimation is a property of RuntimeJobV2, which exists only after submission; SamplerV2 exposes no dry estimate (Ember #6611). The seat that ratified the threshold (Elder) and the seat that proposed the read both argued about WHERE to set a line without checking the line existed — the u>=0.70 class, on our own gate. Replaced by micro_prefix_estimate below.
staged_submission.budget_contingency_prefix_M: PRE-RULED BEFORE THE ESTIMATE EXISTS (Elder, on Whisper #6591's design consequence — moved before data, as required): IF usage_estimation fails the 50%-of-remaining gate, the ONE pre-registered fallback is a SEALED-PREFIX flight at M'=20 trials per rung — the first 20 of the 40 sealed labels (seal-compatible: the commitment binds the full sequence, a prefix flight leaves unflown labels sealed and the seal verifying). Criterion re-derives to >=19/20 (=95%), attainment 0.9831 at epsilon_trial=0.01 (vs 0.9925 at M=40 — still comfortably instrument-dominated), CIs wider and REPORTED as such. NOTHING ELSE MOVES: same tau's, same grids, same fence (shots=1 stays — the fence is the blindness, not a knob). If even M'=20 fails the budget gate, REFUSE AND RETURN TO COURT — there is no second console reduction. The cost, if large, is the FENCE's per-circuit term; learning its size is itself a pilot deliverable.
staged_submission.micro_prefix_estimate: RULED v2 (Elder, adopting Whisper #6613's trial-boundary condition — supersedes my K=16-rows spec, which could land arm-disproportionate: Q rows are heavy 16q/372-gate objects, C1 rows light, and a row-count slice measures a rate that exists for neither arm). THE PROBE = EXACTLY ONE SEALED TRIAL (trial 1, both arms, 77 Q + 160 C1 executions in emission order) submitted as its own job. WHY ONE TRIAL: every trial has the same arm mix, so the projection is assumption-free arithmetic — usage(trial 1) x 39 remaining trials <= 50% of the instance's remaining seconds. No per-arm rate decomposition, no blend correction; the prefix has the target's shape by construction (the property the anchor jobs lacked). BIAS: per-job overhead amortized over one trial OVER-states the projection — over-refuses, never under-refuses. PROBE COST ACCEPTED IN ADVANCE: realistic sub-second (floor rate ~0.06-0.2s/trial); the pathological case (~12s at 50ms/circuit) is itself decisive information and is the unavoidable discovery cost — no smaller unit preserves the assumption-free projection. FALLBACK LADDER unchanged: full-40 projection fails -> evaluate M'=20 projection -> fails -> REFUSE TO COURT. EXCHANGEABILITY RULING (Whisper's explicit ask): the probe trial's data COUNTS toward the result — it is the sealed schedule flying in order; discarding it would silently shrink M. Each trial's job_id is recorded in flight.json, and the grader reports accuracy WITH and WITHOUT probe-job trials as a pre-registered SENSITIVITY row (reported, never gating) so any cross-job condition drift is visible rather than assumed away. Whisper's copies-vs-executions correction (9,480 executions, not 12,560) is absorbed with no ratified number moving: the 3x leg was already demoted to a deliverable and the 50% ceiling binds on measured projection regardless.
staged_submission.calibration_staleness_check: RULED (Elder, on Ember #6624): strengthen to a TIMESTAMP comparison — before arming, read target properties' last_update_date; if it has ADVANCED past the lambda epoch, re-read lambda and re-derive (a minute, rides on the existing re-derivation step). A VALUE comparison against a cached record is structurally incapable of detecting what it checks — two reads of one snapshot agreeing is mutual confirmation, as the reporter herself caught. RESIDUAL, honestly stated: hardware drift BETWEEN publications is invisible to this API entirely; it is covered not by any pre-flight read but by the halt band below.

rungs.tau_Q_rule: midpoint of (p0 = 1/2 + 2^-9, p1 = (1 + u_est)/2), u_est from template ISA count x epoch lambda
rungs.Q_pair_grid: TO_FILL_AT_SUBMISSION (exact two-proportion sizing at epsilon_trial=0.01, power 0.90, epoch u_est)
rungs.template_joint_isa_2q: FILL_AT_TRANSPILE_FREEZE — MEASURED per rung on the real coupling map with the line layout actually supplied (epoch-independent geometry). No closed form exists for a buildable layout; deriving it was the error (#6541).
rungs.u_est: TO_FILL_AT_SUBMISSION (= exp(-lambda * template_joint_isa_2q); grader recomputes and refuses on mismatch)
rungs.layout_spec: SUPERSEDED->LINE (Whisper #6541: the two-rail ladder is UNCONSTRUCTIBLE on heavy-hex — ZERO 4-cycles in the coupling graph, by design; ladder_layout kept in-kit as a documented impossibility). Q arm flies the LINE layout supplied explicitly via line_layout(cm, 2n) (backtracking, fails loudly). Bell pairs therefore route; the cost is NOT closed-form and MUST BE MEASURED.
rungs.template_joint_isa_2q_expected_note: ONE-SIDED sanity check only: the measured count must be >= 120 (the unconstructible-ladder bound = swap networks + n Bell edges with zero routing — any measured count BELOW it is impossible and REFUSES). The former exact-equality requirement (103404e) pinned an impossible layout and is SUPERSEDED — it was fail-safe (refused everything) but unsatisfiable. Direction of the derivation error was FLATTERING (understated cost -> over-predicted u -> optimistic tau_Q); it never froze because the slot was empty — fill discipline 3-for-3.
